fields.statement: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj's PropertyGroup elements declare TargetFramework net10.0, Nullable enable, and ImplicitUsings enable as the file's only target-framework and nullable/implicit-usings settings; declare Version 2.1.0 and no AssemblyVersion or FileVersion property; and declare Title, Copyright, Description, PackageIcon, PackageLicenseExpression, GeneratePackageOnBuild, IncludeSymbols, and SymbolPackageFormat each exactly once as an unconditioned literal value. No PropertyGroup in the file redeclares, conditions, or overrides any of these properties, or names a different TargetFramework, Nullable, or ImplicitUsings value. The file declares exactly one InternalsVisibleTo item, $(MSBuildProjectName).Test, so the only assembly granted visibility into this package's internals through this file's declarations is its own test project, ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.Test.
fields.scope: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj PropertyGroup elements (TargetFramework, Nullable, ImplicitUsings, Version, AssemblyVersion, FileVersion, Title, Copyright, Description, PackageIcon, PackageLicenseExpression, GeneratePackageOnBuild, IncludeSymbols, SymbolPackageFormat) and the file's ItemGroup InternalsVisibleTo declarations.
